translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Abrahaame Hara Naanaa Yeleedda
K'ay Abrahaame K'as'uro geetettiyaa hara machchatto akkeedda.
Iza Ziimiraana, Yok'ishaana, Madaana, Midiyaama, Yishibaak'anne Shuha aw yelaaddu.
Yok'ishaani Saabanne Dadaana yeleedda. Dadaani Ashooreta, Les'uushetanne Le'aamata yeleedda.
Midiyaama naanay Eefa, Eefeera, Hanooka, Abiidaa'anne Elddaa'a. Hawanttu ubbaykka K'as'uri naanaa.
Abrahaame barewaa ubbaa Yisaak'a laatisseedda.
Shin I biro pas'a de'iidde, bare hara machatuwaappe yeleedda naanaatoo barew de'iyaawaappe woyteedda. Bare na'aa Yisaak'appe unttuntta shaakki, away doliyaa bagga biittaw yeddeedda.
Abrahaame Hayk'uwaa
Abrahaame mule itti s'eetanne laappun tammanne ichcheshu laytsaa de'eedda.
Abrahaame daro wodiyaa de'iide, lo"o c'imiide hayk'k'eedda; bare mayzzatuwaanna gaketteedda.
Aa naanay Yisaak'inne Isimaa'eeli Aa Maakip'eela giyaa gonggolo duufuwaan moogeeddino; he gonggoluu Mamire matan, Hiitiyaa S'ohaara na'aa Efiroona gadiyaan de'ee.
Hewenne Abrahaame Hiitetuwaappe shammeedda gadiyaa. Abrahaame bare machata Saara moogetteedda sa'aan moogetteedda.
Abrahaame hayk'k'eeddawaappe guyye, S'oossay Aa na'aa Yisaak'a anjjeedda. He wode Yisaak'i, «Taana Be'iyaa De'uwaa S'oossaa Pulttuwaa» giyaa pulttuwaa matan de'ee.
Isimaa'eela Yeletaa
Saari ayilata, Gibs'eppe yeedda Aggaara, Abrahaamew yeleedda na'aa Isimaa'eela yeletay hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteeddawaa.
Isimaa'eela naanay barenttu suntsaaninne barenttu yeletaa maaran hawantta; hewanttunne: Nabaayoota, K'eedaara, Adibi'eela, Mibssaama,
Mishimaa'a, Duuma, Maasa,
Hadaada, Teema, Yis'ura, Naafiishanne K'eedima.
Isimaa'eela naanay hawantta; unttunttu suntsay unttunttu mootsaaninne de'iyaa sa'aan hawaa. Unttunttu barenttu yaran tammanne laa"u kaappatuwaa.
Isimaa'eeli mule s'eetanne hattamanne laappun laytsaa de'iide, hayk'k'eedda; bare mayzzatuwaanna gaketteedda.
Isimaa'eela zaratuu Gibs'eppe away doliyaa baggan de'iyaa Hawiilappenne Shurappe gidduwaan, Asoora afiyaa ogiyaa matan de'eeddino. Unttunttu barenttu ishatuwaa ubbaanna morkkiyaan de'eeddino.
Yaak'oobinne Eesay Yeletteedda
Abrahaama na'aa Yisaak'a yeletay hawaappe kaaliide s'aafetteeddawaa. Abrahaame Yisaak'a yeleedda.
Yisaak'aw laytsay oytamuwaa gideedda wode, Ribik'o akkeedda; iza Masp'p'es'oomiyaan de'iyaa Sooriyaa Baatu'eela naattiwune Sooriyaa Laabaana michchato.
Yisaak'i bare machata mantsato gideedda diraw, iziw Med'inaa Godaa woosseedda; Med'inaa Goday Aa woosaa siseedda. Yaatina Aa machata Ribik'a shahaaraaddu.
Shin izi ulo giddon de'iyaa naanay mantte gidi uttiide, ittuu ittuwaanna sugetteeddino; yaatina iza, «Hawe taw ayaw hanii?» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Med'inaa Godaa oochchanaw baaddu.
Med'inaa Goday iziw,

content.text: K'ay ne gidduwaan de'iyaa laa"u gade asatuu ittuu ittuwaappe shaakettana;

content: Iza yeliyaa wodii gakkina, izi uluwaan mantte attuma naanay de'iino.
Koyro yeletteeddawe arssa; Aa bollaa ubbaa isikii mayyeedda; hewaa diraw unttunttu Aa Eesaw
giide suntseeddino.
Hewaappe guyye, Aa ishay yeletteedda; I bare kushiyaan Eesaw ginddiyaa oyk'k'i utteedda; hewaa diraw Aa Yaak'ooba
giide suntseeddino. Ribik'a unttuntta yeleedda wode, Yisaak'aw usuppun tammu laytsaa gideedda.
Naanay dic'c'eeddino; Eesay shankkaa hiillaa eriyaa bazuwaa asaa gideedda; shin Yaak'oobi dunkkaaniyaan de'iyaa woppa asaa gideedda.
Yisaak'i Eesaa siik'eedda; ayaw gooppe, I shankkateeddabaappe maanaw doseedda; shin Ribik'a Yaak'ooba siik'aaddu.
Itti gede Yaak'oobi wos'iyaa katsishin, Eesay koshay wod'eeddawe, woraappe yeedda.
Eesay Yaak'ooba, «Taana ha zo'o wos'iyaappe miza; taana koshay wod'eedda» yaageedda. (Hewaa diraw k'ay Aa suntsay Eedooma
geetetteedda).
Yaak'oobi Aa, «Koyro taw ne bayiratetsaa zal"a» yaageedda.
Eesay, «Be'a! Taani hayk'k'ana hanay; ha bayiratetsay taw ayaa go"i de'ii?» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi zaariide, «Ane taw koyro neeni c'aak'k'a» yaageedda. I c'aak'k'eedda; bare bayiratetsaa Yaak'oobaw zal"eedda.
Yaak'oobi Eesaw sooluwaanne missiriyaa wos'iyaa immeedda; I meeddanne usheedda; hewaappe guyye denddiide beedda. Eesay bare bayiratetsaa hawaadan kad'eedda.

footnotes.text: Yaak'ooba: Ha suntsaa biletsay, Ginddiyaa oyk'k'iyaawaa giyaawaa.
